input.title: Kalam
input.style: Intimate South Indian classical instrumental in raga Mohanam for a Telugu engagement morning. Opens with a solo veena alapana over a warm tanpura drone, then a bamboo flute joins in a tender call-and-answer duet, soft mridangam and a gentle ghatam enter in the second half, a light string section swells once near the end and settles back. Unhurried around 72 bpm, auspicious, tender, hopeful, handmade and acoustic, close-miked, warm room sound.
